concept: Photorealistic exploded assembly for scroll animation; visual concept, not a verified CAD diagram.

prompts.base:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a spectacular photorealistic EXPLODED-ASSEMBLY VIEW of this exact red Pagani Huayra BC for a luxury website scroll animation. Reference image defines exact vehicle identity, rear-left elevated camera, red/carbon/electric-blue livery, wheels, material finishes and studio lighting. This is a clean engineering assembly visualization, NOT a destructive explosion: no fire, smoke, debris, broken parts or impact.
Show ONE car disassembled into a small number of clearly separated, complete intact modules suspended in space. Preserve the same rear-left elevated three-quarter perspective (rear nearest camera, nose pointing away toward upper-left), with all modules sharing the same orientation. Arrange with generous visible transparent gaps between modules, no overlaps:
TOP: a complete red and exposed-carbon exterior upper body shell including the cockpit canopy and closed doors, identifiable as this exact Huayra with its red/blue stripes and blue 20, lifted vertically above the chassis.
MIDDLE RIGHT: a beautifully detailed separate AMG V12 powertrain module, polished silver intake plenums, carbon details, gold heat wrap, suspended above its original engine-bay position.
BOTTOM CENTER: the exposed carbon monocoque chassis and flat underfloor, red leather cockpit seats, suspension arms and brake discs, WITHOUT exterior bodywork, WITHOUT engine, WITHOUT wheels. This chassis remains the visual anchor.
SIDES: exactly FOUR individual gunmetal wheel-and-tire assemblies removed laterally from their hubs, two on each side, clearly separate from the chassis and from each other.
UPPER RIGHT: the intact carbon rear wing as a separate detached module, matching the red/blue stripe accent.
All eight modules fully inside the frame, with clear air gaps so they can be animated separately. No extra duplicate car, no additional loose bolts, no labels, no leader lines, no text other than authentic minimal vehicle markings. Ultra-detailed woven carbon, machined metal, tire texture, clean softbox highlights, neutral studio photographic light. Components are intact and plausibly assembled, not abstract futuristic shapes.
TRUE TRANSPARENT background and transparent space between parts; NO white painted backdrop, NO grey checkerboard pixels, NO ground plane, NO shadow backdrop. Wide 16:9 canvas. Entire exploded arrangement centered with 6% clear margins. High-end automotive commercial photographic realism.
prompts.layoutCorrection:
Edit this exploded Pagani artwork into a clean animation-ready assembly plate. Preserve all existing car identity, rear-left perspective, red/carbon/blue colors, materials, detailed chassis, engine, body shell, and neutral photographic studio lighting. Maintain TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND.
Correct exactly these layout issues:
1. Add the missing FOURTH complete gunmetal wheel/tire assembly in the empty upper-left quadrant, centered around x=150,y=290 on this 1672x941 layout. Exactly FOUR detached wheels total; no attached wheels on the chassis or body.
2. Make sure all eight component groups have clear transparent gaps with NO touching or overlap: upper body shell; rear wing; V12 engine; lower chassis; and four wheels. The body shell should not touch the wing or engine, the engine should not touch the chassis, and the lower-left wheel should not touch the chassis. Gently adjust scale/position only as necessary to give each group a minimum 20 pixel clear transparent gap.
3. Remove the redundant rear bumper/diffuser from the floating upper shell so the rear diffuser belongs ONLY to the lower chassis. Keep recognizable red rear quarter panels and carbon engine-cover body styling on the upper shell.
Keep a wide 16:9 canvas, all components fully visible, no labels, leader lines, ground, shadows, checkerboard backdrop, loose bolts or debris. This is an orderly exploded assembly, not a destructive explosion.
prompts.fourthWheel: Precise edit. The reference currently shows exactly THREE detached wheel-and-tire assemblies. ADD ONE MORE detached complete gunmetal wheel with rubber tire in the empty TOP-LEFT CORNER, centered at approximately x=140,y=100, about 150 pixels wide by 175 pixels high on this 1672x941 canvas. This fourth wheel is smaller because it is the far-side wheel. KEEP ALL THREE EXISTING WHEELS EXACTLY WHERE THEY ARE. Do not replace or move any existing wheel. Final visible wheel count must be FOUR, at top-left corner, middle-left, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Change NOTHING else: preserve upper shell, chassis, engine, rear wing, colors, lighting, positions, camera, textures and every other pixel as closely as possible. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, preserve transparency. No labels.
